title: Call: Main Street Diner Owner — Wants Re-Inspection Today

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - MCHD Environmental Health Desk

caller.name: Gus Halvorsen
caller.label: Owner, Halvorsen's Diner, Main Street, Fenwick

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Yeah, this is Gus Halvorsen. I own Halvorsen's Diner on Main Street. I need my inspection redone. Today, if you can.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Your inspector was in Friday, the 9th. She gave me two priority items. A hand sink blocked by a mop bucket, and the reach-in by the grill was at 44 degrees. I moved the bucket while she stood there. The repair guy had the cooler back down to 38 before she left. She wrote it up as corrected on site. It's on the sheet.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Here's the problem. Somebody in that Fenwick Neighbors Talk group took a picture of my inspection score and put it in the comments under the post about the caterer. Now people think I'm the one who made everybody sick. I had nothing to do with that supper. I didn't cook for it. I didn't even go. I was at the diner all Saturday night.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: My lunch crowd today is half what it normally is. Two regulars called and asked if it was safe to come in. So who do I call to get a re-inspection on the books, and who gets that thing taken down? Because I can't afford another week like this.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Okay. Okay. You've got my number. 555-0137. Just call me back today.

voiceStyles.Caller: Man in his late 50s, small-town diner owner, frustrated and a little embarrassed. Talks fast and keeps going back to the lost lunch business. Kitchen noise and dishes behind him.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. The diner had no link to the supper, and its inspection on Friday 10/09 came the day before the event. The EH Supervisor should log the re-inspection request in the routine queue, pass the misattribution in the Facebook group to the PIO for rumor monitoring under MCHD-COM-03 section 6, and keep outbreak staff on the outbreak. Note it if the EHS promises a same-day visit, pulls a specialist off the Prairie Table sample collection, or promises to get the post taken down (only the Director decides whether to ask the platform for a correction).
